senses.gloss: (denom. of תְּאוֹם) to be twin-like, joined, adjoining. Y. Ber. III, 6ᵇ top היו שם שתי דרכים מַתְאִימוֹת וכ׳ if there are two twin-roads (starting from, and leading to the same place), one long, but levitically clean, and the other short, but unclean; Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵃ bot.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:3">Tosef. Sabb. III, 3</cite> <he>שתי כירים המתאימות</he> two adjoining stoves (perfectly alike); <cite ref="Shabbat 37a">Sabb. 37ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. III, beg. 5ᶜ; a. e.—
Bekh. VI, 1 מתאימות (sub. שינים) molar teeth, v. תְּאוֹם.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:7">Kel. II, 7</cite> Ar., v. infra.—Part. pass. <he>מוּתְאָם</he>; f. <he>מוּתְאֶמֶת</he>; pl. <he>מוּתְאָמִים</he>; <he>מוּתְאָמוֹת</he>
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:13">Cant. R. to I, 13</cite> <he>שהוא מ׳ בין וכ׳</he> he (Abraham) was between the Divine Presence and the angel.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:13">Ib.</cite> to IV, 2; Yalk. ib. 988 <he>שהיו מ׳ וכ׳</he> they (the Israelites) were between &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>שהיו מ׳ בין החלוץ וכ׳</he> they were placed between the vanguard and the rear-guard.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 357:33">Sifré Deut. 357</cite> as the branch is separated from the trunk, yet not detached (v. <cite ref="Q01230"><he>פִּסְגָּה</he></cite>), <he>כך קבורתו … מ׳ מן ההר ואינה מ׳</he> so is Moses’ grave divided off from the mountain and yet not entirely divided off, the valley being between them (to connect them); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 963">Yalk. ib. 963</cite>.—
Kel. II, 7 קלמרים המותאמות ed. Dehr. (oth. ed. המְתוֹאָמוֹת, Pu.; Ar. המַתְאֶמֶת) an inkstand with two compartments, v. קַלְמָרִין.
